title: Mino++: Expanded
description: Recreation of a classical card game in Minecraft, with some changes to better reflect the game with the same name.
body:
### Ever wanted to play Uno and be a menace to all your friends?
### Ever thought let's play a very similar but obviously completely different version of it?

## Well this mod is for you!

A fork of https://modrinth.com/mod/minopp and using another fork as a base for my changes (https://github.com/DtHnAme/Minopp-Reforged), in Mino++: Expanded some changes and additions to better reflect the menace of players seen in the UNO game, overall giving more options and customisation to the player for unique games of Mino++

![Villager with a deck of cards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7c368183e2f5d45d2329c4fd71e2d0a2789601b.jpeg)

## Bigger, Better & Customisable!

![Table UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14d6eac33341b578e383024caccddb93e136a9ea.jpeg)

A larger table, and brand new table UI bring a more polished feel to the game, while also adding toggleable rules! Don't like Stacking? No problem, before the game toggle it off and it'll stay off until you decide you'd like it back on.

## New Rules

![Hand Swap GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3570164806a7deeabef14a88dcb667ace54495b1.jpeg)

Expanding from the original Mino++ game, the 7-0 rule has been implemented. Not liking your hand anymore? Play a 7 and choose who you'd like to swap with on the table. Play a 0 to swap everyone's hands in the rotation of play. More rules coming in future...

## Enhanced Experience
![Hand Swap Animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ebc35314b1f44b98db244ebe625db5773d80e70.jpeg)

Confused what's happening? No longer now! Jump-ins when enabled have a longer period for you to jump-in, highlighting in your deck if you have a chance to skip someone's turn! Hand swaps and rotations are now followed with a visual of all the cards moving, to make it clear what is happening. This animation can also be seen when drawing cards, so watch those cards pile up!.

This mod is a progression and expansion of Mino++. All credit for the original game and code goes to the original mod, and credit to the original fork I used as a springboard for my own additions from DtHnAme.
